items.statement: The investigation validates minima and transition states by vibrational analysis and records connectivity evidence.
items.expected: Each reported minimum has zero imaginary frequencies and each reported transition state has one relevant imaginary mode plus a connectivity check.

items.statement: The profile explicitly distinguishes the TXT-assisted aromatization route from the uncatalysed alternative.
items.expected: A catalyst-containing pathway and a catalyst-free comparison are separately identified with their own states and barriers.

items.statement: The calculated profile contains the principal activation barriers reported for the model cycle.
items.expected: Reported comparison targets are TS1A 30.4, uncatalysed TS3A 43.2, TXT-assisted TS3A-TXT 19.8, and TS4A-TXT 32.7 kcal/mol, subject to method and tolerance disclosed by the evaluator.

items.statement: The highest barrier in the catalysed cycle is assigned to deamination.
items.expected: The conclusion identifies TS4A-TXT/deamination as the largest barrier and rate-determining step within the reported model profile.
